verdict.rationale: GitLab documents its own self-managed deployment options: the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart/Operator, and self-compilation. Running your own instance lets you decide where your data physically lives, and community users confirm valuing self-hosting as an alternative to GitLab.com. However, nothing in the evidence documents choosing a region or data-residency location for the hosted GitLab.com service. The community mention of data centers in Asia and Europe concerns latency, not a user-selectable residency control. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for hosted GitLab (SaaS), residency guarantees for AI/Duo data processing, independent corroboration of residency controls.
